comment: Every web/uat/*.mjs is either a flow below or listed in excluded with the reason. `node uat/all.mjs --check` fails otherwise, so a new flow cannot be silently left out of CI. Order matters: flows that mark articles read (keyboard) come last.

excluded.common.mjs: shared set-up of the flows, not a flow
excluded.common.test.mjs: unit tests of common.mjs (run by npm test), not a flow
excluded.faults.mjs: tells a browser fault from a finding, for common.mjs; not a flow
excluded.faults.test.mjs: unit test of faults.mjs (vitest, part of npm test), not a flow
excluded.measure-unload-refusal.mjs: reproduces the measurement behind common.mjs unloadRefusal; prints counts, asserts nothing
excluded.probes.mjs: page helpers of run.mjs, not a flow
excluded.wait-ready.mjs: waits for the seeded instance, not a flow
excluded.wizard.mjs: needs a fresh instance in setup mode (KIPPLE_SEED_SET=fresh), so it cannot share the seeded one
